<observations>
Date: Mar 2, 2026
* 🔴 User is building Ledgerly, a TypeScript invoicing SaaS for Canadian freelancers; teammate Priyanka Vashisht reviews database migrations.
* 🔴 Primary database schema: ledgerly_core.
* ✅ Built PDF generation using PDFKit with passing Jest tests, merged via feature/pdf-generation branch.

Date: Mar 5, 2026
* 🔴 Protected API with JWT auth and added standard-version for automatic releases.
* ✅ Configured GitHub Actions CI workflow (Node 18, build/test) and integrated Stripe for payments (stripe-node v4.5.0).

Date: Mar 8, 2026
* 🔴 Implemented winston audit logging with Loggly HTTP transport.
* ✅ Configured Jest for code coverage (achieved 87%, exceeding 85% goal) and committed audit logging.

Date: Mar 11, 2026
* 🔴 Production Postgres instance runs in Frankfurt region.
* ✅ Added QR code generation (qrcode v1.5.2) to invoices, exposed GET /invoices/:id/pdf streaming endpoint with Prometheus metrics, and updated docs.

Date: Mar 15, 2026
* 🔴 Containerized application with Docker (multi-stage build, node:18-alpine).
* ✅ Added email notifications using nodemailer and Handlebars templates, pushing v1.3.0-staging to GitHub Container Registry.

Date: Mar 19, 2026
* 🔴 User prefers pnpm over npm and wants every install command written with pnpm.
* 🔴 User announced they will begin end-to-end testing of the invoice flow tomorrow.
* ✅ Installed Cypress@13.2.0, added Sentry error tracking (@sentry/node), exposed GET /health endpoint, and applied rate limiting (express-rate-limit) to the PDF endpoint.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Preparing for end-to-end testing of the invoice flow using Cypress (scheduled for tomorrow, Mar 20).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should acknowledge the upcoming end-to-end testing phase, confirm adherence to the pnpm preference for any future package installations, and ask if the user needs any assistance with the Cypress setup or test scenarios.
</suggested-response>
